 Youth Leadership Program 
 Fairfax County Youth Leadership Program (FCYLP)
 The Fairfax County Youth Leadership Program (FCYLP) is designed to educate and motivate high school students to become engaged residents and leaders in the community. 
 Accepted students participate in monthly learning sessions, complete a three-week paid internship in a Fairfax County department, and act as "ambassadors" for the program by speaking to middle school civics classes. They will also learn about local government's role in their everyday lives and are given an opportunity to interact with County leaders and policy-makers.
 More information on the background of FCYLP is available. 
 The application process for the current class of Juniors is now OPEN. The updated brochure for class of 2027-2028 is now available, with applications being due November 8, 2026. 
 Additional Information
 Eligibility
 Students applying for the FCYLP must meet the following criteria:
 Fairfax County Public School (FCPS) Junior
 In good academic standing
 An interest in local government
 Please note that students are unable to participate in both the FCYLP and Governor School Program.
 Program Requirements
 The FCYLP is a highly competitive one-year program that is committed to building future leaders within the community. Students accepted must commit to the following activities:
 Attend monthly meetings, held on Wednesdays from 4-6pm starting in February
 Participate in a three-week internship in July, 40 hours per week
 Complete a monthly reflection and deliver a presentation to an 8th grade civics class
 Conduct a group interview with one member of the Board of Supervisors and watch part of a budget public hearing
 Arrange own transportation to meetings and internship
 Students may have only one absence from monthly meetings during the year to qualify for graduation. 
 Why Apply?
 In addition to making connections and building skills to be job ready, accepted students will have the opportunity to:
 Earn $1,000 for successfully completing the 3-week internship 
 Gain professional experience and build their resume
 Build self-confidence and enhance leadership skills
 Get a clearer vision of how local government works through real-life experiences
 An internship is an excellent way to make connections and build your professional network. Be sure to apply for the FCYLP today!
 Application Process
 Applications for the 2027-2028 class of Juniors are now being accepted, with applications being due no later than 11:59 p.m. on Sunday, November 8, 2026.
 Note: One letter of recommendation is required as part of the application (teacher, scout leader, employment supervisor, etc.)
 Students will be notified regarding acceptance decisions via email in mid-December
 The first monthly meeting will be held in February 2027
 Questions? Email DMBYLP@fairfaxcounty.gov
